items.name: Chicken
items.effect: Yields one ration of food when slaughtered (Cooking, page 103).
items.description: A small domesticated bird, often kept for its eggs and meat.

items.name: Combat Trained Horse
items.effect: Can carry one rider and 10 weight units, or two riders.
items.description: A horse trained for battle, capable of carrying a rider and their gear.

items.name: Cow
items.effect: Yields D4 rations of food (milk) per day, and 2D10 rations of food when slaughtered (Cooking, page 103).
items.description: A large domesticated animal, often kept for its milk and meat.

items.name: Donkey
items.effect: Can carry 10 weight units. Cannot be ridden.
items.description: A small, sturdy animal, often used for carrying loads.

items.name: Guard Dog
items.effect: Protects its owner. For stats, see page 99.
items.description: A trained dog, often used for protection and companionship.

items.name: Homing Pigeon in Cage
items.effect: Flies home to its dovecote when released, wherever it is.
items.description: A trained pigeon, often used for communication.

items.name: Pig
items.effect: Yields 2D6 rations of food when slaughtered (Cooking, page 103).
items.description: A domesticated animal, often kept for its meat.

items.name: Riding Horse
items.effect: Can carry one rider and 10 weight units.
items.description: A horse trained for riding, capable of carrying a rider and their gear.

items.name: Sheep
items.effect: Yields 2D4 rations of food when slaughtered (Cooking, page 103).
items.description: A domesticated animal, often kept for its wool and meat.
